Unique tech column, full-sentence descriptions, verified Blob Storage

Read from each repo's packages and non-test source. The empty space under each app's picture now holds a full description.

What moved

  1. MOVED Extras became Unique tech, the rightmost column: the libraries and APIs only that app uses, one per line, with a hint saying what each does. Examples: PoMiniGames three.js · Tone.js · SharpGLTF · QRCoder; PoRepoLineTracker LibGit2Sharp · Roslyn · GitHub API; PoMode ONNX Runtime · Whisper.net · AcoustID · DryWetMidi · tus uploads.
  2. TEXT The description moved from a two-line clamp beside the picture to a full sentence under it, across the cell. Every description was rewritten from its README, and three were wrong before: PoWatch ("Personal watchlist app" — it is a webcam observer), PoSeeReview ("Review and feedback productivity tool" — it turns restaurant reviews into comics) and PoLocalCompare ("comparison tool for local options" — it is an AI model arena).
  3. DATA Blob Storage is listed only where non-test code really reads or writes blobs. Checked: it was already right (PoRepoLineTracker and PoTraffic are Table-only, PoMode is Blob-only). The hint now says what each app keeps in blobs, e.g. "recorded fight audio and profile images".
  4. PHONE A multi-line cell's ⓘ stays beside its list instead of dropping to a line of its own.
